name: chipmate
displayName: ChipMate: AI Coding Agent, Copilot, and Autocomplete
description: Open Source AI coding agent that generates code from natural language, automates tasks, and runs terminal commands. Features inline autocomplete, browser automation, automated refactoring, and custom modes for planning, coding, and debugging. Supports 500+ AI models including Claude (Anthropic), Gemini, Grok, GPT, Codex and GLM.

kilo-code.new.autocomplete.model.description: Model to use for inline autocomplete suggestions. If unset, the recommended default is used.

kilo-code.new.autocomplete.provider.description: Connected provider ID to use for inline autocomplete suggestions. If unset, the runtime selects an eligible provider or the recommended fallback.

kilo.autocomplete.qwen.maxPromptTokens.description: Continue-style prompt token budget for qwen-direct autocomplete context.

kilo.autocomplete.qwen.prefixPercentage.description: Continue-style fraction of prompt budget reserved for prefix context.

kilo.autocomplete.qwen.maxSuffixPercenta.description: Continue-style maximum fraction of prompt budget reserved for suffix context.

kilo.autocomplete.qwen.modelTimeout.description: Continue autocomplete model timeout setting retained for qwen-direct helper parity diagnostics.

kilo.autocomplete.qwen.cache.enabled.description: Enable Continue-style in-memory qwen-direct autocomplete cache reuse.

kilo.autocomplete.qwen.prefixChars.description: Legacy compatibility limit retained for qwen-direct autocomplete settings; Continue-style token budget controls default prompt pruning.

kilo.autocomplete.qwen.suffixChars.description: Legacy compatibility limit retained for qwen-direct autocomplete settings; Continue-style token budget controls default prompt pruning.

kilo.autocomplete.qwen.multifileContext..description: Enable Continue-style lightweight multi-file context for FIM autocomplete.

kilo.autocomplete.qwen.contextLength.description: Explicit qwen-direct autocomplete model context length. Zero means unknown and disables snippet prompt injection.

kilo.autocomplete.qwen.context.recentlyE.description: Enable opt-in qwen-direct autocomplete recently edited range context collection.
Inject selected recently edited snippets into the qwen-coder multifile FIM autocomplete prompt when context length is safe.
Maximum recently edited ranges retained in memory for qwen-direct autocomplete.
Maximum lines retained per recently edited range for qwen-direct autocomplete.

kilo.autocomplete.qwen.context.recentlyO.description: Enable opt-in qwen-direct autocomplete recently opened file context collection.
Inject selected recently opened file snippets into the qwen-coder multifile FIM autocomplete prompt when context length is safe.
Maximum recently opened file paths retained in memory for qwen-direct autocomplete.
Per-file read timeout in milliseconds for qwen-direct recently opened autocomplete context.

kilo.autocomplete.qwen.context.importDef.description: Enable opt-in qwen-direct autocomplete import definition context collection.
Inject selected import definition snippets into the qwen-coder multifile FIM autocomplete prompt when context length is safe.
Timeout in milliseconds for qwen-direct import definition lookup and range reads.
Maximum import definition file-info entries retained in memory for qwen-direct autocomplete.

kilo.autocomplete.qwen.context.rootPath..description: Enable opt-in qwen-direct autocomplete root path context collection.
Inject selected root path snippets into the qwen-coder multifile FIM autocomplete prompt when context length is safe.
Timeout in milliseconds for qwen-direct root path definition lookup and range reads.
Maximum root path snippet entries retained in memory for qwen-direct autocomplete.

kilo.autocomplete.qwen.logLevel.description: Diagnostic log level for qwen-direct autocomplete.

kilo.autocomplete.qwen.logPromptPreview.description: Include short redacted prompt previews in qwen-direct debug diagnostics.

kilo.autocomplete.qwen.logCompletionPrev.description: Include short redacted completion previews in qwen-direct debug diagnostics.

kilo-code.new.speechToText.model.description: Model to use for experimental speech-to-text voice input. Requires ChipMate Gateway.

kilo-code.new.claudeCodeCompat.description: Load CLAUDE.md instructions and skills from your Claude Code configuration directory into ChipMate sessions. Enable this if you want ChipMate to use your Claude Code instructions and skills.

kilo-code.new.extraCaCerts.description: Absolute path to a PEM file containing extra CA certificates to trust when the ChipMate backend makes HTTPS requests (sets NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS on the CLI process). Use this if you're behind a corporate proxy that performs SSL inspection. Leave empty to rely on the OS trust store.

kilo-code.new.autoApprove.enabled.description: Start ChipMate with the main auto-approve toggle enabled. When enabled, permission prompts are approved automatically.

kilo-code.new.fontSize.description: Font size in pixels for the ChipMate webview UI.

kilo-code.new.browserAutomation.enabled.description: Enable browser automation powered by Playwright. When enabled, the AI agent can interact with web pages in a visible Chrome window.

kilo-code.new.browserAutomation.useSyste.description: Use your system's installed Chrome browser instead of downloading a separate Chromium instance.

kilo-code.new.browserAutomation.headless.description: Run browser automation in headless mode (no visible window). When disabled, you can watch the agent interact with the browser.

kilo-code.new.notifications.agent.description: Show notification when agent completes a task

kilo-code.new.sounds.agent.description: Sound to play when agent completes

kilo-code.new.sounds.permissions.description: Sound to play on permission requests

kilo-code.new.showTaskTimeline.description: Show the task timeline graph in the chat header

kilo-code.new.diff.renderMarkdown.description: Render Markdown files in ChipMate diff viewers by default. Toggle this from a Markdown file header in the diff viewer.

scripts.compile: bun run prepare:cli-binary -- --force && bun run rebuild-sdk && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.watch: bun run rebuild-sdk && bun run --parallel watch:esbuild watch:tsc
scripts.package: bun run prepare:cli-binary && bun run rebuild-sdk && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: bun run compile-tests && bun run compile && bun run lint
scripts.typecheck: bun run check-types:extension && bun run check-types:webview
